masterBinding: 单页MD绑定；母稿装订及包含证明由主任务另行记录，不替换旧单页SHA。
reviewMeaning: 实际查看中文完整原页图及所列英文对应原页图，核对全部正文、行内/无编号/编号式、算法每步、数表每格、题号难度推荐标记。模型直接核对，不声称人类签核。
pageFurnitureOmitted: 重复页眉/书名/节号/页码，以隐藏锚点保留页定位。
coveredRegions: H算法续证；S1–S4、D1–D4所有幂/取整/模条件/循环顺序；调整系数引言、8/9完整式及次数、页尾续句。

substantiveCorrections.location: D1前导数算法运算次数句
substantiveCorrections.original: 用2n−1次加法和n+sqrt(2n)次乘法/除法来完成计算
substantiveCorrections.final: 用2n−1次加法和大约n+sqrt(2n)次乘法/除法来完成计算
substantiveCorrections.basis: 恢复英文原文明确的about限定，不能把有取整/端点开销的近似次数误作精确计数。其余数字、算法与条件保持。

numericScope: Three exact general sparse polynomial identities: normalized quartic9/10; sextic12–14 under displayed cubic constraint; Pan16–19 after clearing its nonzero denominator. AlgorithmH/S/D and complex3 verified on explicitly listed finite basis ranges; finite checks do not establish arbitrary-degree algorithms/real-root TheoremE or optimality/free-dimension results. All exact rational arithmetic; no floating tolerance.
